worldcombat.skill.metalsound.summary: Grind your own metal together to send a horrible high-pitched sound through cover and into a foe's ears, harshly lowering its Sp. Def. Pulling the sound out takes a long windup standing still; a long grind cuts deeper and rings longer but is slower.
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.use.0: Grind away a Sp. Def wall through cover
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.use.1: Keep a large Sp. Def drop up for a whole exchange
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.use.2: Start safely behind a wall, then send the sound through
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.description: The target loses %1$s stages of Sp. Def and the resonance rings for about %2$s.
The sound reaches ears %1$s blocks away and scrapes out about %2$s sound rings; cover does not stop it.
worldcombat.skill.metalsound.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
Off (quick scrape): faster to pull out and a shorter cooldown, with the base drop and resonance. On (long grind): you grind it out, resonance about x1.45, Sp. Def one stage lower, but +5 ticks of telegraph and +20 ticks of cooldown. Grinding longer presses deeper while you stand exposed.
Only consider the grind when a threat is within this distance; smaller stays close, larger chases first.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to deliver the metal sound.
world_combat.move.metalsound.text.grate: Metal Sound grates in its ears (Sp. Def -%1$s)
